'''Chaospheres''' were weapons developed by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Mekhis]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. Mekhis deployed the chaospheres during the [[Battle of Rhen Var]].
